text_block_list.text:
—At last, the morning of the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) had arrived.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Where's that usual bravado of yours? 
Like, 'I'm gonna win this in style!' or 
whatever."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ha. What happened to your whole 'I'm 
number one' declaration, huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... I just decided I didn't need it 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'll show them all with my own running. 
That I am the "Number One."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: To everyone... and to you, too.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Haha, you really say it like it is.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'll agree with you for today. I'm 
gonna blow right past you with my own 
running.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...*inhale*... *exhale*... It's almost 
time for the Tenno Sho (Autumn) to begin.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Heheh, what are you even talking about?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I am Daiwa Scarlet, the number one 
Umamusume! I won't lose to anyone!
